authority_boundary: Routine contracts are operational health metadata only. A healthy status never proves output quality or authorizes any write; routine outputs remain candidate evidence under normal DAD review. Registering a routine here does not schedule or enable it.

statuses.alive: Expected artifact exists (and parses when parse_json is set) and its age is within freshness_hours.
statuses.stale: Artifact exists and parses but is older than freshness_hours.
statuses.dead: Artifact is expected on a cadence but is missing, or the artifact exists and fails its parse check.
statuses.never_ran: On-demand routine (freshness_hours null) with no artifact yet; informational, not a failure.
statuses.missing_dependency: A declared dependency path or executable is missing, so the routine cannot run at all.
statuses.disabled: Contract explicitly disabled; recorded for inventory, dependencies still reported.

methodology.notes: Statuses are deterministic boolean checks over file existence, parseability, and modification age. No score, weighting, or model judgment is involved. This registry exists because three orphan-radar surfaces ran divergently with no output contract and none was detected (2026-07-16).
